translations.text: [?] many peoples estranged from God through defilement, filth, theft, and every evil deed. This is how it will be in the last days: whoever wishes to be righteous among those who live
in this place, whether male or female, will be compelled by God to be faithful among many peoples estranged from God through filth, deceit, and every kind of lawlessness.
And at that time, theft, lying, laughter, joking, their mockery of one another, slander, grumbling, excessive greed, and favoritism,
and insatiability, boasting, blasphemy with idle words, fights, rivalries, hatred, jealousy, hostility, quarrels with one another, and foolishness,
and ignorance—these and many other things will no longer be counted as sins by the ungodly who will be among you at that time, whether male or female.
And because their evil deeds have multiplied, they will not understand that children who have become defiled are alien to God, according to the Scriptures.

For this reason, the sexual immorality of their hearts will exceed the sexual immorality of their loins, and the sexual immorality of their loins will exceed the sexual immorality of their hearts. Both will rise up against them
as they gorge themselves on food and drink and many luxuries, especially as they become increasingly idle and inactive, neglecting all the righteousness of God.
And because they have not put to death their earthly members—sexual immorality, impurity, negligence, and all the rest—Satan will rise up against them
with all his defiling activities, from which we flee, out of all the congregations and out of their midst. And they will commit acts of sexual immorality, defilement, and filth,
and many deceptions through Satan and his unclean spirits, who counsel me about the evil that will happen at that time.
And at that time, righteousness, truth, and every kind of diligence will hide themselves from those unclean people, and lying and negligence will assert themselves boldly over them.
But righteousness, truth, and every kind of diligence will not hide themselves from the faithful who will live at that time—or rather, even now. And it will never happen.
Nor will lawlessness, lying, and every kind of negligence assert themselves boldly over the faithful who will live at that time—or rather, even now. And it will never happen.
Therefore, just as now every believer in every congregation that follows our way of life—or rather, everyone who fears
the Lord everywhere—acts boldly in all righteousness and every good deed, trampling on every kind of lawlessness and deceit,
so too the believers who will be here at that time, together with everyone everywhere, will act boldly in righteousness and every good deed, and they will trample on
Satan and all his filth and all his impurities. Neither the devil nor a sinful person nor any lawlessness whatsoever will be able to hinder them at any time, as they cry out to the Lord in truth.
Instead, they will prevail mightily over Satan and all his other evil deeds, and they will prove themselves especially righteous through their righteous deeds in the midst
of the wicked who will exist at that time, like Abel, who was righteous in every kind of righteousness in the midst of Cain, who was truly ungodly beyond all people.
And like Enoch and Noah and all the others who were righteous in every kind of righteousness among all those whom God wiped from the earth in a flood of abundant water.
And like Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who were righteous in every kind of righteousness among all those who oppressed them.
And like Lot among the people of Sodom and Gomorrah, who were truly ungodly and more wicked than anyone else, according to the Scriptures.

And like Moses, Aaron, Miriam, and Joshua, who were righteous in every kind of righteousness among those who were disobedient, those who grumbled, those who committed sexual immorality, and those who craved food they did not have.
And like the judges who were righteous in every kind of righteousness among all these people, some of whom are those who abandoned God and followed foreign gods.
Not only did the holy people please God among those of their own number who became ungodly, but they also proved truly good and faithful before the Lord among the nations that do not know God.
And all the prophets, all the apostles, all the saints, and everyone who fears the Lord, from the beginning down to this very day,
have been righteous in every kind of righteousness among those who are godless [?] and abominable before God, from the beginning until now.
We have said these things in this way so that we may understand that, just as neither the devil nor anyone who sins has been able to hinder any person from the beginning until now,
so they will never be able to hinder them, because Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
Everyone who wishes [?] to fulfill all righteousness is supported by God in the good desires of their heart. And
everyone who wishes to carry out their evil deeds at any time is supported by Satan in the evil desires of their heart.
But just as all the saints were afflicted among the ungodly who existed from the beginning,
so the righteous will also be afflicted among all the ungodly, in every congregation that has come into being in our way of life, and in every place where people sin throughout the whole earth.
And in this same way, the faithful who will be among us in the last days will also be greatly afflicted.
And just as the prophet’s word is being fulfilled at this present time concerning every congregation that follows our way of life,
because of those who sin within them: “How have you turned bitter, you vine that has become estranged from God through your defilements and all your abominations?”
so too, in the last days, the prophet’s word will be fulfilled concerning those who live in this place, because of those among them who will sin, whether male or female,
as he says: “The Lord called their name ‘an olive tree, beautiful to look at, providing shade.’ At the sound of its stripping, however, a fire has now blazed up against it.”
Great is the affliction that is upon [?].
For its branches have become useless, from the beginning until now, and forever.
For everyone who sins anywhere in the whole earth, the words of the prophets are fulfilled concerning them, saying, “I will sing to the beloved about my
vineyard with a song of love.” And after all the words he spoke that follow these, he says, “I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.”
Look, the rest of these words are on the sheets written earlier.
so too a righteous king is courageous, together with those who belong to him, and is always among them.

And whenever their enemies come to fight against them and all those who belong to the king, they rise up against their enemies and overtake them, and they do not return until they have destroyed them.
This is also how it is whenever everyone, at all times, keeps the Lord’s commandments in every congregation, in every place throughout the whole earth: God is with them.
And whenever Satan rises against them to fight them, they call on the name of the King of glory, Jesus, the Lord, the mighty and strong one,
the Lord who is powerful in battle. And he sends them help through his holy angels, and they pursue the enemies,
the demons—everyone with whom the Lord is present. And they do not turn back until they have uprooted Satan and all his other evil works.
Therefore, just as all our holy fathers, from righteous Abel down to today, drove Satan and every evil deed out of themselves
and their congregations, their sons, their daughters, their brothers, their companions, and everyone who fears the Lord, who had been taught and had obeyed them in everything,
so it is now and forever: all who keep God's commandments drive the devils and all their other works out of themselves, like people pursuing robbers
who want to plunder houses full of silver and gold. And they pursue them within their congregations like people pursuing wild beasts that want to seize and scatter the sheep of the flock.

And they drive them out of their sons, their daughters, and their companions, like those who pursue foxes that want to destroy very fine vineyards, according to the Scriptures: “Catch for me little foxes that destroy the vineyards.”
And in the same way, they also drive them out of everyone who fears the Lord, receives their instruction, and keeps their words.
And if everyone at all times pays attention to what they do in every good work, and does not waver in the teaching of those who teach them from the Scriptures
in the fear of the Lord, they will pursue Satan and every evil deed and blow them away through the power of the Spirit of God, like chaff that a strong wind
carries far away, and like straw and dust that no one will ever fear, which the wind sweeps away from the face of the whole earth, according to the Scriptures.

In this same way, at all times and forever, we will never fear tens of thousands of demons fighting against us all around, as it is written. But just as Satan has prevailed from the beginning over everyone because of their evil deeds,
so he also prevails over everyone who lies and refuses to listen to those who teach them from the Scriptures in the fear of the Lord.
Therefore, if people sin while others are pleading with them not to sin, then how much lawlessness will be committed
by people who love evil when those who command them not to sin in the Lord's presence depart from them?
And this is how Moses spoke in anguish: “While I am still with you, you provoke God. How, then, will you not provoke him after my death?”

Therefore, it is no wonder that some of us sinned while our holy fathers who have fallen asleep were pleading with us. Nor is it any wonder that they sinned after our holy fathers who have fallen asleep departed from us.
It is no wonder if they sin while our fathers who are with us now plead with us, weeping over us and urging
us, forcefully commanding us to keep the commandments and adjuring us by the Lord Jesus not to act deceitfully in the Lord's presence.
Nor, again, is it any wonder if we sin when our fathers who are with us now, who grieve over us day and night, depart from us.
Has any prophet ever arisen in Israel like Moses?
And great multitudes sinned after he had departed from them, and after he had instructed them with all his words, after they had seen many wonders.
Is there anyone superior to all the prophets? Yet great multitudes sinned after the prophets had commanded them through all their words, and after they had seen many wonders.
Is there anyone greater than Jesus, the Son of God? Yet great multitudes sinned after he had commanded them through all his words, and after they had seen countless signs and wonders.

Is there anyone, then, mightier in power than our fathers the apostles? Yet very many people sinned after the apostles had commanded them with all their words, after they had seen many signs and wonders.
If, then, all these people sinned while all these holy people were with them, each in his own time,
and while the Lord Jesus himself, the Son of God, was also with them on earth,
and all these people who fell away from the hope of eternal life sinned—not only did many peoples sin while all these holy people were with them,
but many peoples, beyond counting, also sinned after all these holy people had departed from them on the day of their visitation,
just as we too now sin, or have sinned, after hearing the words of all these holy people, those of the apostles, those of the prophets, those of our Lord
Jesus, and those of all our fathers from the beginning—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—and all the words of everyone who fears the Lord, down to this very day.
And if, after all these things, we sinned before the Lord, not only in our fathers’ house, in our childhood and our ignorance, but also after we had received a share in the knowledge of the truth,
And if those who want to fulfill their desires at all times sin fearlessly in the Lord's presence, like the angels who left
behind their original position and committed sexual immorality with the daughters of the people of ancient times, and like all the others who have sinned from the beginning down to the present,
And who, then, is Shenoute, or what are all his words, that he could prevent or restrain people among us who love evil, whether male or female, who want to carry out their sins at all times

through deceit, theft, oaths sworn in vain, fighting, and false accusations against one another, like this man who falsely accused his brothers, saying that they had sinned, although he did not know whether they had sinned or had not done so?
But in fact it is he who sinned in many ways: first, he defiled the temple of God in his childhood.
And when he confessed his sexual immorality, at the time when the fear of the Lord was examining him through the person questioning him,
who wanted to help him, to take him out of Satan’s hands, to pull him out of the mire of lawlessness, and to save him from God’s wrath.
yet again, after some years, he turned back and denied the truth, though no one questioned him.
